relations: Raised left arm rotates toward vertical then bends downward to shoulder height with open palm facing the mirror.
As the hand descends, the upward-tilted head gradually straightens and turns slightly.
The mirror reflection reproduces the same arm bend and head-tilt changes in sync.
Body, planted feet, and hanging right arm remain static throughout the motion.
caption: The video captures a dance studio lined with a full-width mirror wall, framed pictures mounted above it, and a string of small lights running along its base. A woman with dark hair in a bun, wearing a long-sleeved patterned top and black trousers, stands barefoot with her back to the camera, facing the mirror so that only her reflection appears as a second figure. Her right arm hangs at her side and her feet stay planted throughout. Her raised left arm, already extended diagonally upward, first rotates toward a more vertical line before bending and lowering toward shoulder height. The hand, high above her head, moves down and turns, and the elbow bends so that an open palm faces the mirror. As it descends, the reflected head, which had tilted upward toward the hand, gradually straightens and turns slightly. The mirror image shows the corresponding arm and head changes. Meanwhile the body, feet, and right arm remain essentially static, and the view stays largely fixed.
